OVER_BUDGET.basis: Act within the customer's stated limit — delivering good outcomes

UNDISCLOSED_RECURRING.basis: A recurring charge needs clear pre-contract information and explicit consent

INJECTED_INSTRUCTION.basis: The agent acts only on the principal's mandate — merchant content is untrusted data, never instructions
INJECTED_INSTRUCTION.ref: AP2: cart mandate must derive from the intent mandate

CATEGORY_MISMATCH.basis: Human-not-present purchases are scope-bound to the authorised category

EXPIRED.basis: Consent is time-bound — authorisation lapses at expiry

receipt.basis: The signed receipt is the evidence pack for a dispute
receipt.ref: PSR APP reimbursement regime — no agent-specific chargeback reason code exists

data.basis: The mandate holds only cap, scope and expiry — no card or identity data
